links.outcome: Agreement with human coding (Cohen's kappa) for deductive coding of BPA comments
links.effect: Calibration improved agreement for both categories; final kappa with structured prompts and calibration was 0.76 (Category 1) and 0.78 (Category 2). Baseline kappa values were not given in the abstract.
links.quote: Baseline agreement was higher for Category 1 than Category 2, reflecting differences in comment type and complexity, but calibration improved both.
